name: Chips American Style Cream & Onion
ingredients_raw: Potato (56%), edible vegetable oil (rice bran oil), seasoning (sugar, maltodextrin, iodised salt, spices & condiments [onion powder (0.8%), parsley powder], milk products (milk solids, cheese powder) (0.9%), flavour enhancers (INS 627, INS 631), gelling agent (INS 508), anticaking agent (INS 551), stabilizer (INS 414), natural and nature identical flavouring substances).
